repo.description:
### Impact

Non-privileged users can modify tags on files they should not have access to via bulk tagging.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 31.0.1.
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 31.0.1.

### Workarounds

* No workaround available

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3040887)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/51288)
* [Public ticket](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/51247)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Users can modify tags on files that do not belong to them
